mapper.insert: insert into community ( community_content, created_at, updated_at, community_view_count, community_like_count, community_reply_count, community_deleted, user_no) values ( #{communityContent}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{communityViewCount}, #{communityLikeCount}, #{communityReplyCount}, #{communityDeleted}, 1 );
mapper.select: select * from community where community_no = #{communityNo} and community_deleted = "n";

select c.*, u.user_name, u.user_no, pr.photo_url as profile_photo, group_concat(p.photo_url) as post_photo from community c left join user u on c.user_no = u.user_no left join photo pr on pr.related_entity_id = u.user_no and pr.related_type = 'USER' left join photo p on p.related_entity_id = c.community_no and p.related_type = 'COMMUNITY' where c.community_no = #{communityNo} and c.community_deleted = "n" group by c.community_no, u.user_name, u.user_no, pr.photo_url;
mapper.insert: insert into community_reply ( reply_parent_no, reply_content, created_at, reply_deleted, community_no, user_no ) values ( #{replyParentNo}, #{replyContent}, #{createdAt}, #{replyDeleted}, #{communityNo}, 2 );
mapper.select: select * from community_reply where community_no = #{communityNo} and reply_deleted = "n" order by created_at
